class.name: NetwPredictStats
class.brief_description: What one entity's prediction engine counted.
class.description: Read it through [member NetwPredictionHandle.stats]. A count is for reading, printing and charting. A rule a game acts on hangs on the [NetwPredictionHandle] signals. [codeblock] var stats := NetwEntity.of(self).prediction.stats print("%d corrections" % stats.corrections) [/codeblock]
